messages.text: I live in the Dallas Fort Worth area of Texas. Which cultivar should I plant. I want to be successful in this endeavor.

Hello Maureen,

The best choices for the Dallas–Fort Worth area are Green Milkweed (Asclepias viridis) and Asclepias tuberosa . Both are well-suited to North Texas, support monarchs, and handle local heat and drought better than non-native types.

We remain at your disposal if you have any further questions.

Warmly,

Hari
Thank you. I'll try and get my order in today.
